refutationNotes.R01: A cold TRUNCATE followed by INSERT and UPDATE through a reordered leaf produced the correct 99|v|m. Persistent corruption in this concrete schedule was not reproduced. Separate dropped-column or immediate OOB hypotheses remain C11.
refutationNotes.numericDeleteVariant: DELETE WHERE numeric_literal does not itself change the stored tuple's wire representation. The demonstrated case instead holds UPDATE 1.0 to 2 before execution and inserts 1.00 in the next transaction.
refutationNotes.triggerEnableSyntax: ENABLE ALWAYS TRIGGER ALL is not valid syntax. The harness enables actual named FK triggers using a catalog-driven DO block.
refutationNotes.scope: No source fix, sanitizer proof, production-build assertion behavior, or benchmark is claimed. No failed reviewer attempt counts as independent coverage.
